characteristic: 1. 空地联运组合偏好高 (Air-Ground Intermodal Combo)
core_finding: 游客极度偏好“飞机空中俯瞰 + 陆地 Hummer 越野车/Skywalk 玻璃桥”跨界联运产品（48.63% 点评提及）
sample_quote: “Flying over the canyon and then taking the Hummer ground tour was the ultimate way to experience it!”

characteristic: 2. 选线双重分化明显 (South Rim vs West Rim Duality)
core_finding: 南缘 (South Rim, 26.8%) 侧重自然原始与极致宏大；西缘 (West Rim, 14.2%) 侧重离 Vegas 近、玻璃桥与谷底降落
sample_quote: “South rim views were endless, while West rim Skywalk gave us that thrilling edge!”

characteristic: 3. 时间价值极高 (Time-Saving Value via Aviation)
core_finding: 游客将飞行视为“避免 8 小时长途拉车”的最佳替代方案，高度认可空中交通的时间节省价值（36.51% 提及）
sample_quote: “Worth every penny to save 8 hours of driving from Phoenix!”

characteristic: 4. 宏大尺度超越照片预期 ("Pictures Do Not Do Justice")
core_finding: 游客反复强调“照片完全拍不出实景万分之一的宏大”，高空视角带来了打破常态经验的尺度震慑（28.44% 提及）
sample_quote: “No picture can ever do justice to the sheer scale when you see it from the air!”
